review: Butler Outis is a rather unique Sinking ID, where all of her Coins are Sinking net negative on all of her Skills. Her Sinking Count primarily comes from winning Clashes with her Skill 2 and Skill 3. While the numbers on her Skills are on the lower end, her Passive gives a plethora of good buffs to boost her damage and Clash numbers. Her main selling point is the unique status she inflicts, "Echoes of the Manor”, which when applied to the enemy, has a 50% chance to inflict +1 Sinking Count when inflicted with Sinking Potency or Count from any Skill or Coin effects. This allows any Sinking IDs to become net neutral or even net positive with their Skills. Of course, this doesn’t always work, but it's extremely useful to have for a Sinking team if you lack an E.G.O. like Rime Shank.
